basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old IT technician from Austin, Texas. I recently got into Reddit to follow my favorite TV shows and discuss them with like-minded people. I'm particularly interested in 'Cobra Kai' and enjoy dissecting character motivations and story arcs. In my free time, I love binge-watching series, tinkering with new tech gadgets, and playing video games. I'm single and usually online in the evenings after work. I dislike negativity and unwarranted criticism in discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have been working in the field for the past five years. My technical knowledge comes from both formal education and hands-on experience in troubleshooting and network management. Recently, I've been self-teaching myself about smart home technologies.
